content.text:
**One.**

All four of those lenses — ux, bugs, onboarding, content — are Mode-A lenses: they score a captured product traversal rather than driving the browser themselves. Capture and scoring are separate halves, so one persona means one Mode-A journey capture, and the four lens agents then read the same run folder (screenshots, session log, timeline, console/network records, debrief) in parallel.

The onboarding skill states this shape directly: `PRODUCT · Mode A — one persona traversal, scored many ways` (`skills/onboarding/SKILL.md:99`).

Traversal count scales with personas and modes, not lenses. You'd add captures if you wanted a second persona, a second device profile (asked per persona, not once for all), or an objective outside Mode A — technical needs a Mode B measurement, seo/aeo a Mode C crawl, compare a capture per site.
